independent finite-field reconstruction and independent clique enumeration
correctness.rationale: The finite theorem was independently reconstructed from field arithmetic rather than trusted from a saved log. Affine normalization gives exactly 60 distinct \([5,3]_7\) row spaces. Fresh modular row reduction over \(\mathbb F_7\) reproduced 1200 compatible pairs of intersection dimension one, 570 pairs of dimension two, and a 40-regular compatibility graph. An independently implemented Bron--Kerbosch enumeration gave maximal-clique histogram \(30,1920,5070,1800,138\) at sizes \(6,7,8,9,10\), respectively, with clique number 10. This independently matches the displayed ten-code witness and establishes the finite upper bound.

evidence: The motivating paper gives asymptotic lower bounds for k at least three and exact dimension-two behavior.
